tei:div.tei:p: 317) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: dbang chen rtsa sgrub ye shes rab 'bar bzhugs: 318) na mo pad+ma kro dha ye:

dbang chen he ru ka la 'dud: bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gisaḥ ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i don du yang: zab bcud sna tshogs gter du sbas: rang skal gang ldan chos la spyod: 'di ni bla med khyad du 'phags: skal ldan gsang ba 'dzin pa yis: dkyil 'khor gsum du bsgrub pa'i thabs: yang gsang snying po'i gdams pa bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: (Dakini secret letter here) : de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: na mo: rang rig sku gsum don dam he ru ka: gnyis med klong yangs chen por skyabs su mchi: ma rtogs 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba kun: gnyug ma'i rang zhal mjal bar 319)sems bskyed do: āḥ bsam brjod bral ba ka dag ngang: 'dzin med rang gdangs snying rje'i rtsal: 'gag med rang gsal cho 'phrul las: bh+rūm̐ 'phros dbang chen gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs: lhun grub bkod pa rab mdzes pho brang dbus: pad+ma nyi zla bdud bgegs bsnol ba'i steng: rig pa hrīḥyig dmar po yongs gyur las: bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum gtum la rngams: phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas thog khrag bsnams: sku la khro bo'i chas rnams ma 320)lus rdzogs: bde stong mngon gyur phag mo gnyis med 'khril: mthing skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: sku la khro mo'i chas kun yongs su rdzogasaḥ zhabs gnyis yab kyi sku la 'khril sbyor mdzad: spyi gtsug phag zhal nag pos ngur sgra sgrog: yab yum gnyis med ye shes me klong bzhugs: de yi phyi rim rang las sprul pa yi: sras mchog rigs lnga dpa' bo ḍā ki bzhi: khro bcu dregs pa sde brgyad sgo ma bzhi: sku mdog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur du ma sogs: ma 'dres lhun grub yongs rdzogs chen por gsal: gtso dang 'khor gyi rnam par shar ba kun: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dam ye dbyer med bstim: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ hrīḥ 'og min gsang chen rol pa nas:

dbang chenalha tshogs ma lus kun: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla bdud bgegs steng: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med bzhugs: rang rig rang gsal yi dam lha: rang zhal mjal phyir ye phyag 'tshal: ka dag rang rtsal lhun grub shar: snang srid mchod pa'i rgyan du 'bul: chags bral don dam 321) he ru ka'iḥ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: grub brnyes mchog gi dngos grub stsol: nyams chag nyes ltung ci bsags pa: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya= āḥ 'dzab dgongs ni: dpa' bo yab kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hrīḥdamar po'i mtha' mar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus sngags phreng la thim: rgyal kun ye shes yon tan mthu stobs dang ldan par bsam: oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro ta h+ya grī wa sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes bzla dpa' bo yab sngags soḥ dpa' mo yum gyi thugs kar chos 'byung dga' 'khyil gyi klong du ye shes sems ma bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' bskor du rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yon du 'khor bar bsgom: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes bzla dpa' mo yum sngags so: rigs lnga'i thugs kar rang rang gi thugs srog sa bon las 'od zer 'phros: don gnyis bsgrub cing tshur 'dus sngags phreng la thimaḥ sngags phreng sku las 'od zer 'phros pas 322)las rnams gang 'dod thogs med du 'grub par bsam: oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: oṃ rat+na kro dha= oṃ karma kro dha= oṃ bud+dha kro dha= zhes bzla sras mchog rigs lnga'i snying po'o: dpa' bo yab yum thugs kar rang rang gi thugs srog sa bon gyi mtha' mar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar sgomasaḥ ra tsa hrīḥya ha ri ni sa dza: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥ

zhes bzla 'khor sngags rtsa ba'i snying po'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma ngo mtshar smad byung a ti zab mo'i chos: yang gsang gab pa mngon phyung gdams pa mchog: dbang chen sgrub thabs ye shes rab 'bar 'di: a tsar sa le khyod kyis yi ger thob: chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong du brda ru btab: ma 'ongs chos 'di spyod pa'i skal ldan ni: mkhan chen gsung gi sprul pa dang phrad nas: bstan 'gro'i rgud pa lnga bcu'i bar du sel: 'brel tshad don ldan 'og min zhing la spyod: the tshom ma byed gdams pa nyams su longs: tshe 'dir rkyen zhi dpal 'byor longs spyod ldan: phyi ma bde chen zhing du skye bar nges: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can dang 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung 323) dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: snod min dam nyams lag tu ma shor bar: thub par srungs shig badz+ra sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: ཿ (Dakini secret letter here) ces pa 'di yang gsang grogs sa man+ta dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ chos bdag kirti tra ya sogs kyis nan cher bskul ngor chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong nas su kha badz+ra gyis gdan drangs pa'o// thun mtshams mchod bstod ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dngos yid ting 'dzin las sprul pa'i: phyi nang gsang mchod bsam mi khyab: dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dngos grub rnamaganyis stsol: oṃ pad+ma kro ta sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs: shap+da rū pa= sogs: spar+she sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta gu h+ya sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi: hrīḥ bde gshegs gsung gi dbang phyug he ru ka: rab 'jigs skur bzhengs gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: bdud dpung zil gnon rngams brjid skur bzhengs pa: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang dang drag po'i phrin las dngos grub stsol: dge bas 'gro kun sdug bsngal las grol nas: bde chen dag pa'i zhing la spyod par shog:
324) ces pa'ang su kha'i ming gis bris pa'o//
